title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2/Chopper Drop
text:
Somewhere off the coast of Hawaii is a mechanical structure where a skater can have some fun without anybody else bothering them. Mess around with the halfpipe, jump to the pier below, or even grind the edge of the chopper: it's all up to you.

Strategy
thumb|240px|Own the halfpipe.This level is the smallest of the bunch and there's not a lot to do. You'll start by going down the rollin into the halfpipe and from there, you can do your best vert tricks while going back and forth. Jump off the lip of the pipe with a No Comply or Boneless, do a grab move with some rotations, and end it with a simple flip trick. When you're ready, you can head over to the ramp that points toward the dock and do a Boneless at the edge of it. You should be able to clear the distance if you have the speed. If you cross the finish line on the dock, you'll go back to the heli with your special meter reset, so keep that in mind when you decide to jump for the dock.

Gaps
Air Gaps
 thumb|240px|70ft70ft, 80ft, 90ft (100, 200, and 300 points): At one end of the halfpipe, you should see a large rollin on one end and a ramp that leads to a dock at the other. Gain some speed, launch off the ramp and land on the dock. How far you go determines which gaps you get.
 Into the Heli (500 points): Use the rollin to ollie up to the helicopter and get back in.

Grind Gaps
 thumb|240px|Heli Grind1 Potato (100 points): In front of the rollin and behind the halfpipe is a mast with several rungs. Grind the bottom rung.
 2 Potato (200 points): In front of the rollin and behind the halfpipe is a mast with several rungs. Grind the rung above "1 Potato".
 3 Potato (400 points): In front of the rollin and behind the halfpipe is a mast with several rungs. Grind the rung above "1 Potato" and "2 Potato".
 Heli Grind (500 points): Use the rollin to ollie up to the helicopter and grind the edge of its platform. It has to be from the rollin to the heli for it to count.

Lip Gaps
 Whoomah (500 points): Use the rollin to ollie up to the helicopter and lip the edge of its platform. You need to stay perfectly straight to lip it.
